title: Cloud migration prerequisites for Business Central

facts.text: Destination online environment must have Business Central online tenant with at least one user having SUPER permissions in target company.
Install latest versions of Intelligent Cloud Base and Business Central Intelligent Cloud apps in online environment before migration.
Source on-premises must run Business Central version 25.0 or later; earlier versions require upgrade before cloud migration.
Database must use SQL Server 2016 SP1 or later with compatibility level 130 or higher and TCP/IP enabled.
SQL Server authentication login must have sysadmin role at server level and db_owner role at database level.
Self-hosted integration runtime machine needs sufficient resources matching requirements in Azure Data Factory documentation.
Users without SUPER permissions are reassigned to intelligent cloud user group with read-only access during migration.
